{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'Number of QA test orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check for nulls in revenue
print(f'Nulls in revenue: {df["revenue"].isnull().sum()}')

# Show first few revenue values
print(df['revenue'].head())"}
